title: An item carries typed external tracker ids that backlog.json validates, commits and merge requests carry, and brief and find print
goal: An item has an external field, a map of tracker name to id list (such as jira to PROJ-123, or gitlab to an issue number), written by new and set --external TRACKER=ID (--add-external appends) and never by hand; backlog.json's trackers key names each tracker's id pattern and url template, check refuses an id that matches its tracker's pattern in no way or a tracker the file does not name, and a project without a trackers key accepts none; brief prints them with their urls; the commits claim and done make carry one KB-Ref: <id> trailer per id (a form a tracker's smart-commit parser reads), check-trailers accepts it, and land writes the ids and urls into the merge request description; find matches an id as it matches a word of the title. The kb's own backlog.json names no tracker, so nothing changes for the kb's items.
notes: Order in SP-befc6yqr: second, after ST-qgnjxiol, which creates _tools/test_backlog_portable.py (the one new test file of the epic, within the 15-file ceiling); its -k external_ids test goes into that file. Its selector collects no test until the work adds it.
